text:
rafael: Opening the 01:00 UTC change window. Goal: enable router header-split with TTL-aware sticky routing (x-rd-routing + session-ttl) and roll a quantized runtime variant (kernel_quantized=true) to opt-in clusters. Need api pinned to v2.15.0-hotfix before router flip. Canary plan: 5% 8m -> 30% 12m -> 100% (fast-path if metrics clean).

jia: ack. I've added the console blurb and a small how-to showing the session-ttl slider. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pull/4312

orla: api pin done (v2.15.0-hotfix). Tag verified in registry, and release artifact matches checksum.

deploybot: created wave wave-176234-A covering: api, router, runtime-quantized, console. Canary schedule: 5% for 8m, 30% for 12m, then 100%. Pins: api -> v2.15.0-hotfix.

rafael: preflight list: api pin \u2705, runtime image pushed \u2705, router flag staged \u2705, console note \u2705, observability panel ready \u2705, rollback runbook linked.

infra-watch: dashboard: https://observability.redwood/dash/940 - tracking x-rd-routing ratio, api 5xx, embeddings-error-rate, runtime restarts. Alerts to #eng-oncall.

mika: pushed quantized runtime image to canary pool (tag: runtime-quant-q1). Smoke in staging: p95 -10ms, throughput +4%, token generation quality unchanged on eval set. Memory usage down ~12% but CPU slightly higher.

deploybot: runtime-quantized rollout started (job id rb-176234-rt). Canary nodes: 10.

jia: flipping router header on 5% canary now. Note: router will set session-ttl for sticky buckets to 15m for split-v2 lane. Quick curl test:
```
curl -H "x-rd-routing: split-v2" -H "x-session-ttl: 900" https://api.redwood.internal/health
```
responds 200 from canary.

infra-watch: early metrics t+2m: api 5xx = 0.02% (baseline 0.03%), embeddings-error-rate 0.01%, router split-v2=48% of canary traffic. No alerts.

rafael: Rolling to 30% if stable for remaining 6m. Rollback thresholds: api 5xx >0.6% sustained for 4m OR embeddings-error-rate increase >0.4% absolute OR runtime pod restarts >2 in 10m.

mika: observed one runtime pod restart on shard-9 at t+5m; it recovered and restarted with new image. I collected logs: GC pause spike. Increasing GC headroom for the canary set.

deploybot: progressing to 30% (wave wave-176234-A). Noted one transient 503 from router during backend reconnection.

jia: updated release_notes.md: "Router: header + session-ttl routing rollout (x-rd-routing). Runtime: quantized kernel variant (kernel_quantized=true) available in opt-in clusters. See console for enabling and session-ttl details."

infra-watch: t+18m aggregated: p95 +9ms, api 5xx 0.04%, embeddings error stable. Trend nominal.

rafael: proceeding to 100% after a 10m observation window. Reminder: if embeddings-quality regression appears in user-facing evals, fall back api to previous pinned build and set router flag to split-v1.

deploybot: final rollout to 100% completed for api/router/runtime-quantized/console. wave-176234-A closed.

infra-watch: post-rollout t+45m: api 5xx 0.05%, embeddings-error-rate unchanged, runtime pod restarts normalized. No incidents.

orla: publishing release note and sending digest to Support and SRE with links to runbook and dashboard.

rafael: thanks all. If anything odd overnight, call the rollback procedure in the runbook and ping #eng-oncall.
